protocol.base: E1 plus E2 configuration, unchanged learning rules
protocol.interpretation: Exploratory stress screening with two seeds. This cannot establish broad confidence or replace a larger final replication.
requirements: Do not use context IDs in learner inputs
Count all router and update work
Prediction benchmarks do not satisfy closed-loop task requirement

configuration.scope: Foundation only: prediction and context reuse; no general reasoning or long-horizon task-success claim
configuration.learner_interface: predict(x) then observe(x,y); context IDs supplied only to the labeled oracle upper bound
configuration.comparisons: Same experience stream and one optimizer update per batch; not claimed equal FLOPs. Count inference over all experts and replay training inputs.
failure_rules: No oracle task IDs in non-oracle arms
No future targets in prediction
No test outcomes for learning or checkpoint selection
Report all seeds, failures, costs and capacity escapes
Do not tune this protocol after seeing registered outcomes; use a separately named follow-up
configuration.relation_to_e1: Exploratory follow-up after E1. E1 code and outputs remain unchanged.
configuration.hypothesis: Protecting persistent models during context identification improves return-task performance without oracle task IDs
configuration.cost_rules: Same observations and optimizer updates; count all model scoring, temporary parameters and peak tensor state; do not claim equal FLOPs
configuration.success_scope: Necessary context-retention subproblem only. No completion claim for the overall architecture.
adversarial_followups_required: many contexts and exhausted module capacity
